featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience with this shop. I purchased crash guard, sump guard, visor and backrest for my Royal Enfield Hunter 350 for ₹5800. After installation, the crash guard was not fitting properly and the backrest did not even have a proper bolt structure. The visor fitting was also very poor.

I went to three different mechanics and even the authorised service centre, and they all said these are cheap quality accessories and not suitable for the Hunter 350.

When I went back to the shop for a refund, they refused and only tried to adjust the parts in-house, but the fitting issue was still not resolved. Because of safety concerns, I had to remove all the accessories.

I paid through online payment and expected proper quality and service, but the experience was extremely disappointing. Since the issue has not been resolved, I am now proceeding with a consumer complaint and will submit my payment proof and product photos as evidence.

I would advise other customers to be careful before purchasing accessories from this shop.
